tagline: Building sustainable infrastructure and renewable energy capacity
hero_kpi_rationale: Installed capacity is the main structural growth indicator for ACCIONA, reflecting its expansion strategy in renewable energy.

ai_positioning.summary: ACCIONA does not mention any strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in the documents provided. The company focuses on green infrastructure, renewable energy, concessions and renewable asset management.

kpis.name: Net Ordinary Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital Expenditures — investments in property, plant and equipment.
kpis.description: Ordinary net capex reached EUR 1.538 billion in 2024, mainly in the development of new renewable capacity.

kpis.name: Total Consolidated Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue — total sales generated over the period.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue reaches EUR 19.190 billion in 2024, up 12.7% thanks to the Infrastructure division and the full consolidation of Nordex.

kpis.name: Consolidated EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization.
kpis.description: Consolidated EBITDA reaches EUR 2.455 billion in 2024, up 24.0% from 2023 (EUR 1.981 billion).

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin is 6.86% in 2024 (EUR 1,316M / EUR 19,190M), up from 6.37% in 2023.

kpis.name: Net Financial Debt
kpis.explanation: Financial debt after deduction of liquidity, including IFRS 16 impacts.
kpis.description: Net financial debt (including IFRS 16) reaches EUR 7.128 billion at end of 2024, rising, but the Net Debt/EBITDA ratio drops to 2.90x.

kpis.name: Net Financial Debt to EBITDA Ratio
kpis.explanation: Key indicator of solvency and debt repayment capacity.
kpis.description: The ratio falls from 3.31x at end of 2023 to 2.90x at end of 2024, a sign of solid EBITDA generation and improved capital structure.

kpis.name: Total Installed Capacity
kpis.explanation: Total power of renewable energy assets in operation.
kpis.description: Total installed capacity reaches 15,354 GW at end of 2024, after adding 2 GW of new renewable capacity, with a consolidated capacity of 13,630 GW.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability
